# Quiet File Team MCP

> Six free offline MCP tools that explain, configure and check a Quiet File Team (several bots sharing one computer through files). No network calls, no paid APIs, no disk reads of your machine.

Install (Python 3.11+ and uv, no token):

```
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team-mcp.git@v0.1.0 quiet-file-team-mcp
```

Tools: explain_method, generate_team_config, generate_early_exit, validate_layout_manifest, draft_workflow, draft_owner_batch.

Editions:

- Free MCP companion (this page): https://pandadad0214.github.io/quiet-file-team-mcp/ and https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team-mcp/
- Free Bash core: https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team
- Paid Agensi setup kit (live price on the listing): https://agensi.io/skills/quiet-file-team-setup-kit
- Paid Apify setup-kit generator (live price on the Store): https://apify.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team-setup

This page exposes read-only WebMCP tools: list_servers, list_tools, get_install_command, get_links, list_editions. Catalog: webmcp-catalog.json
- X: https://x.com/PandaFedHQ  (Follow on X: @PandaFedHQ)
